implementation: Implemented an ordered Candidate→Offline→Shadow→Human Approval→Bounded Canary→Independent Activation→Rollback model lifecycle. Evaluation, approval, canary, activation and rollback are separate immutable facts; controlled SFT is limited to eligibility assessment over authorized, deidentified, validated data with held-out evaluation evidence.

tests.v5_regression: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run pytest tests/contract/test_v5_001_tick_replay.py tests/contract/test_v5_002_order_book.py tests/contract/test_v5_003_paper_adapter.py tests/contract/test_v5_004_algorithms.py tests/contract/test_v5_005_exposure.py tests/contract/test_v5_006_calibration.py tests/contract/test_v5_007_governance_steward.py tests/contract/test_v5_008_model_evaluation_pipeline.py -q
tests.full_gate_result: lock, format, ruff, mypy over 167 source files, secret scan, 2 schema, 1 unit, 18 property, 902 contract, and health passed

acceptance_mapping.no_auto_traffic: ModelCandidate has no activation or traffic method; only ModelEvaluationPipeline can advance state, and resolve_active rejects every state except independently ACTIVE.
acceptance_mapping.offline_shadow: OFFLINE and SHADOW evidence require traffic_fraction=0 and must pass in order.
acceptance_mapping.human_approval: Approval is a distinct immutable fact, requires a user actor and binds offline plus shadow evidence digests.
acceptance_mapping.bounded_canary: Canary starts only after approval and complete rollback evidence; its traffic fraction is strictly between zero and one.
acceptance_mapping.independent_activation: Activation occurs only after passed canary and separately binds approval, canary and rollback evidence plus explicit scope and user actor.
acceptance_mapping.rollback: Rollback requires an active candidate, tested evidence and human actor and records target, time and evidence digest.
acceptance_mapping.controlled_sft: SFT eligibility requires authorized, deidentified and validated sources plus held-out evaluation; ineligible or mismatched assessment blocks candidate registration.

limitations: This task evaluates SFT eligibility and lifecycle controls; it does not train a model or infer that SFT is beneficial.
All active scope remains simulation-only; no model receives real trading authority.
model_output_not_authoritative: State changes are owned by deterministic phase gates and human approval/activation facts, not candidate model output.
